say:1:1410336001:0.text: Ah, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's been a few days, hasn't it?
say:1:1410336001:0.male: Ah, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's been a few days, hasn't it?
say:1:1410336001:0.female: Ah, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's been a few days, hasn't it?

say:2:1410336002:1.text: Didn't expect to run into you here. How are you faring?
say:2:1410336002:1.source_cn: 没想到，能在这碰见……你们身体恢复了吗？

say:4:1410336003:1.text: Thanks for asking! We're all doing well.
say:4:1410336003:1.source_cn: 谢谢你的关心，我们一切都好。

say:5:1410336004:2.text: Good, good! And how'd the inspection go? If you've still got an appetite for knowledge, I'd be honored to give you another tour.
say:5:1410336004:2.source_cn: 视察了一番，还满意吗？我再陪你们四处看看？

choice_prompt:6:1410336004.text: Good, good! And how'd the inspection go? If you've still got an appetite for knowledge, I'd be honored to give you another tour.
choice_prompt:6:1410336004.source_cn: 视察了一番，还满意吗？我再陪你们四处看看？

say:7:1410336005:0.text: Huh? The general didn't tell you himself? Must've been in quite the rush.
say:7:1410336005:0.source_cn: 嗯？霍根将军什么都没说吗？一定是他走得太急了。

say:8:1410336006:0.text: He received word of an urgent matter and set sail back to Holistone immediately.
say:8:1410336006:0.source_cn: 将军大人他收到了传信，说是有什么突发状况，已经返航圣石镇了。

say:9:1410336007:0.text: If all's gone well, he should be more than halfway there by now.
say:9:1410336007:0.source_cn: 要是一路顺风的话，估计航程都过半了。

choice_prompt:10:1410336007.text: If all's gone well, he should be more than halfway there by now.
choice_prompt:10:1410336007.source_cn: 要是一路顺风的话，估计航程都过半了。

say:11:1410336008:0.text: This is a major matter. I would never lie to an envoy.
say:11:1410336008:0.source_cn: 这种大事，我怎么有胆子骗特使大人呢！
say:11:1410336008:0.male: This is a major matter. I would never lie to an envoy.
say:11:1410336008:0.female: This is a major matter. I would never lie to an envoy.

say:12:1410336009:0.text: Alright, if you need reassurance—by Dura's name, I swear it!
say:12:1410336009:0.source_cn: 嗯，这样吧，我以艾雅之名起誓！

choice_prompt:13:1410336009.text: Alright, if you need reassurance—by Dura's name, I swear it!
choice_prompt:13:1410336009.source_cn: 嗯，这样吧，我以艾雅之名起誓！

say:14:1410336010:1.text: Well, uh... I mentioned Dura because it would put you Empire people more at ease!
say:14:1410336010:1.source_cn: 这就有点……我的意思是，向两位神明起誓也不太好吧？

say:16:1410336011:0.text: You say he left, but the ship we arrived on is still docked.
say:16:1410336011:0.source_cn: 你说霍根将军走了，那为什么我们来时乘坐的船还在？

say:17:1410336012:0.text: That's right! If he's gone, what ship did he take?
say:17:1410336012:0.source_cn: 没错，霍根将军到底是怎么离开的？

say:19:1410336013:2.text: Ours, of course! It's much sturdier and built to withstand these unruly tides. I can't have the general risking his neck on a less seaworthy vessel.
say:19:1410336013:2.source_cn: 当然是乘坐我们的船了，我们的船更加坚固，最近海面上风浪...

say:20:1410336014:0.text: Oh, speaking of which, I'll need to arrange proper transport for you as well. Head to the armory and wait there. I'll handle the rest.
say:20:1410336014:0.source_cn: 对了对了，我也得为你们准备一艘船。请在装备库旁稍等，我...

say:23:1410336015:0.text: Magister, I think Eldric is lying. Something's wrong...
say:23:1410336015:0.source_cn: 主人，我认为弗林在撒谎。霍根将军可能出事了……
say:23:1410336015:0.male: Magister, I think Eldric is lying. Something's wrong...
say:23:1410336015:0.female: Magister, I think Eldric is lying. Something's wrong...

choice_prompt:24:1410336015.female: Magister, I think Eldric is lying. Something's wrong...
